description: Climate Change Adaptation Resource Center (ARC-X) is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by EPA, U.S. Environmental Protection Agency. This interactive resource can help local governments effectively deliver services to their communities even as the climate changes. Decision makers can create an integrated package of information tailored specifically to their needs. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Air Quality, Drought, Extreme Heat, Flooding – General, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Water Quality. Assets: Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property, Water Infrastructure – General. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
